import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    chars = list(s)
    n = len(chars)
    boundaries = []
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if i == n or chars[i] != chars[i - 1]:
            boundaries.append(i)
    count = 0
    start = 0
    for end in boundaries:
        if ((end - start) & 1) == 0:
            count += 1
        start = end
    print(count, end='')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
